title: dpia.requirement_determined payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `dpia.requirement_determined`. Published even when `dpia_required` is false: a consumer that never sees this event for an activity knows the gate has not been evaluated, not that it passed. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
